review_scope: Deterministic lexical review of the 1,614 existing exact normalized-name mappings; no remapping and no fuzzy matching.
normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse whitespace, casefold
result: Seven exact matches contain explicit form/origin qualifiers such as recombinant, unspecified form, or formaldehyde inactivated; each qualifier is present identically on both sides. No obvious lexical mismatch or route/formulation collapse was found. This is a conservative lexical audit, not an authoritative pharmacological identity validation.
frozen_cohort_policy: The frozen cohort was not changed. If a future authoritative crosswalk changes a mapping, the cohort construction and evaluation would require an evaluation-only rerun; model retraining would not be required.
